is.t: HOW TO USE THIS BILLING WORKBOOK
Replace YOUR COMPANY NAME, address, contact details, GSTIN and PAN on the GST Invoice sheet.
Fill invoice number/date, customer details, place of supply, supply type and shipment/container details.
Enter quantity, rate and GST rate for each service row. Taxable amount and GST amount calculate automatically.
Select Intra-state for CGST + SGST, or Inter-state for IGST. Confirm the correct GST rate and SAC with your tax advisor before issuing.
The GST Invoice sheet is set to print on one A4 landscape page. Use Print Preview before issuing.
Enter one row per invoice/container in Billing Register. Invoice Total is calculated automatically. Use filters to view a customer, container or payment status.
Enter each customer name once in column A of Customer Summary. Invoice count, taxable value, GST, total and paid/outstanding figures calculate from the register.
Mark invoices Paid, Part Paid, Pending or Overdue. The summary counts fully Paid invoices as paid; update the register for part payments as needed.
This is a customizable template, not tax advice. Validate SAC/HSN applicability, GST rates, place of supply, invoice particulars and statutory requirements for your specific services.
